content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Campaign and Event Sync ## slug: campaign-to-event-sync ## seoTitle: Campaign and Event Sync ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Salesforce {{variable.Object_Campaign}}s synced with {{variable.Object_Event}}s is an extremely powerful way to link together your marketing initiatives and the registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s that are generated as a result. When paired up with a powerful Email marketing tool, you can take automation to the next level. > The general principle behind combining Email Marketing tools with Salesforce/Campaigns is that you can build lists, segment data, and send out email campaigns, directly from within Salesforce. Some of this functionality is evident with tools like Pardot, Campaign Monitor, and Mailchimp that all have their own Salesforce connectors. > ![Campaign Sync](https://youtu.be/-vo5eQJdFeM?si=aKPYbTLAYM7mzAa5){height="480" width="640"} ## Prerequisite Campaign access is only available to users with full Salesforce licenses and at least the Blackthorn | Event (Organizer) permission set. Accessing Campaign related features without a Platform license can result in errors. ## Initial Setup There are fields and buttons to add to {{variable.Object_Campaign}} and {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} Page Layouts. 1. On the {{variable.Object_Campaign}} Page Layout, add the {{variable.Field_Campaign_Event}} field and the {{variable.Button_Campaign_AddAttendees}} button. 2. On the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} Page Layout, add the {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Attendee}} and {{variable.Field_CampaignMemb_AttendeeLin}} fields. ## Invite Attendees from the Campaign ### Relate an Event to your Campaign To start, we have to relate an {{variable.Object_Event}} to the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}. This field must be defined to create and invite {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s for an {{variable.Object_Event}} from {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}s. 1. Set the {{variable.Field_Campaign_Event}} lookup field on the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}. ![releate event to campaign](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/releate%20event%20to%20campaign.png){height="" width=""} **Note:** When the {{variable.Field_Campaign_Event}} lookup is populated on the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}, the same {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Campaign}} lookup on {{variable.Object_Event}} is populated. ### Configuring the Attendee Registration Status The following {{variable.Object_Campaign}} object fields ensure the corresponding {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} or {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} field reflects the value in the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}'s {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} field. If a {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}'s {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} is updated, the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} on the related {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record will be updated. ![configure attendee registration status](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/configure%20attendee%20registration%20status.png){height="" width=""} #### Attendee "To Invite" Status Define the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created with a {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = "To Invite." For example, the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}'s {{variable.Field_Campaign_AttInviteStatus}} field is set to "To be invited." When a new {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created and the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}'s {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} is set to "To be invited," the related {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is set to "To Invite." #### Attendee "Invited" Status Define the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created with a {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = "Invited." For example, the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}'s {{variable.Field_Campaign_AttInvitedStatu}} field is set to "Sent." When a new {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created and the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}'s {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} is set to "Sent," the related {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is set to "Invited." #### Attendee "Registered" Status Define the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created with a {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = "Registered." For example, the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}'s {{variable.Field_Campaign_AttRegistStatus}} field is set to "Responded." When a new {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created and the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}'s {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} is set to "Responded," the related {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is set to "Registered." #### Attendee "Attended" Status Define the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created with an {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} = "Attended." For example, the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}'s {{variable.Field_Campaign_AttendedStatus}} field is set to "Attended." When a new {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created and the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}'s {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} is set to "Attended," the related {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} is set to "Attended." #### Attendee "Declined" Status Define the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created with a {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = "Declined." For example, the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}'s {{variable.Field_Campaign_ADeclinedStatus}} field is set to "Unable to Attend." When a new {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created and the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}'s {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} is set to "Unable to Attend," the related {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is set to "Declined." #### Attendee "Canceled" Status Define the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created with a {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = "Canceled." For example, the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}'s {{variable.Field_Campaign_ACanceledStatus}} field is set to "Official Cancelation." When a new {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created and the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}'s {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} is set to "Official Cancelation," the related {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} is set to "Canceled." #### Attendee "No Show" Status Define the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created with an {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} = "No Show." For example, the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}'s {{variable.Field_Campaign_AttNoShowStatus}} field is set to "Did Not Attend." When a new {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is created and the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}'s {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} is set to "Did Not Attend," the related {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} is set to "No Show." ### Update Page Layouts Before auto-adding {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}s, confirm that the following fields are visible on the related objects’ page layouts. #### Campaign Object Complete the following steps to add the {{variable.Field_Campaign_EventAutoSync}} field to the {{variable.Object_Campaign}} page layout. 1. Go to the Object Manager. 2. In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Campaign.” 3. Click the Page Layouts tab. 4. Select the layout you want to update. 5. Locate the {{variable.Field_Campaign_EventAutoSync}} field and drag and drop it on the layout. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. #### Event Settings Object Add the {{variable.Field_ETSettings_CampMemInvSta}} and {{variable.Field_ETSettings_CampMemTOInSt}} fields to the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} page layout. 1. Go to the Object Manager. 2. In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Event Settings.” 3. Click the Page Layouts tab. 4. Click the layout you want to update. 5. Locate the {{variable.Field_ETSettings_CampMemInvSta}} field and drag and drop it on the layout. 6. Locate the {{variable.Field_ETSettings_CampMemTOInSt}} field and drag and drop it on the layout. 7. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ### Auto Add Campaign Members #### How the Fields Work {{variable.Field_ETSettings_CampMemInvSta}} (Campaign_Member_Invited_Status__c) * When a {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} is invited to the {{variable.Object_Event}}, their {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} will be updated with the value in the {{variable.Field_ETSettings_CampMemInvSta}} field. * If the {{variable.Field_ETSettings_CampMemInvSta}} field is blank, the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} will be set to “Sent.” {{variable.Field_ETSettings_CampMemTOInSt}} (Campaign_Member_To_Invite_Status__c) * When a {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} is waiting for an invitation to the {{variable.Object_Event}}, their {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} will be updated with the value in the {{variable.Field_ETSettings_CampMemTOInSt}} field. * If the {{variable.Field_ETSettings_CampMemTOInSt}} field is blank, the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} is set to “Sent.” {{variable.Field_Campaign_EventAutoSync}} (conference360__Event_Auto_Sync__c) * If {{variable.Field_Campaign_EventAutoSync}} = “Yes.,” the following will occur. * When you create a {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} in a {{variable.Object_Campaign}}, and the {{variable.Object_Campaign}} is related to an {{variable.Object_Event}}, then the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record is created automatically and added to the {{variable.Object_Event}}. * If there are existing {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}s in a {{variable.Object_Campaign}}, and you set {{variable.Field_Campaign_EventAutoSync}} = “Yes,” only new {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}s will have {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records created. * If {{variable.Field_Campaign_EventAutoSync}} = “No,” the following will occur. * If you create a {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} in a {{variable.Object_Campaign}} and the {{variable.Object_Campaign}} is related to an {{variable.Object_Event}}, the newly created {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record will not be added to the {{variable.Object_Event}}. #### Configure the Campaign Record to Auto-Add Campaign Members 1. Open a {{variable.Object_Campaign}} record. 2. Set the {{variable.Object_Campaign}} {{variable.Field_Campaign_EventAutoSync}} field to "Yes" to automatically add new {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}s as {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s to a related {{variable.Object_Event}}. 3. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. The auto-sync feature can also perform the following tasks. * Create {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}s with the same {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} as the Status designated on the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}}. * Set a {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}’s {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} to correspond with the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = “To Invite”. ***Important note*** about {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s created as {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}s. If an {{variable.Object_Event}} is related to a {{variable.Object_Campaign}} and you register {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s for the {{variable.Object_Event}}, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s will be created automatically as {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}s. The status in the {{variable.Field_Campaign_EventAutoSync}} field does not change this functionality. #### Mass Add Campaign Members If you add five or more Campaign Members and auto-sync is turned on, a scheduled job, that will add members as Attendees in 30 minutes, will be created. If you need Campaign Members to be added as Attendees in less than 30 minutes, turn off the sync feature, mass add the members, and click the **Add Attendees** button. #### Upload Campaign Members Uploading a bulk amount of {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}s will take some time as it becomes a scheduled job. The scheduled job runs an hour later to convert the newly inserted members as {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s. Each batch job will insert 30 {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s at a time. After it processes, the {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} record is updated with the {{variable.Field_CampaignMemb_AttendeeID}} and {{variable.Field_CampaignMemb_AttendeeLin}}. This process runs automatically only when a new {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} is inserted. #### Existing Campaign Members Click the {{variable.Button_Campaign_AddAttendees}} button to add existing {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}s as {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s for a specific {{variable.Object_Event}}. When Attendees are added to an Event from a Campaign, the BT Event Attendee Duplicate Rule will be respected, and duplicate records will not be created. If {{variable.Field_ETSetting_1UniqAttEmail}} = "True" (checked), then all but the individual duplicate Attendee record will be processed. However, if a user clicks the **Add Attendees** button on a Campaign record, Attendees will be synced to the related Event even if the Event Settings’ {{variable.Field_ETSetting_1UniqAttEmail}} = “True” (checked). This will happen even if a duplicate Attendee is identified in the Attendees list. ### Send Invite to All Attendees :::(Warning) (Verify the Invite Email Before Sending) Please verify the invite email before sending clicking **Send Invite**. If you are using the out-of-the=box flow provided, your Campaign Members will immediately receive the invite email when you click the **Send Invite** button. ::: On the {{variable.Object_Event}} add the button {{variable.Button_ET_SendInvite}}. Clicking this button will update the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} {{variable.Field_Attendee_RegistratStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Invited}}. If your Salesforce Flow {{variable.Workflow_SendBTEventInvitemail}} is set to "Active", this will trigger the sending of the invite to your {{variable.Object_Attendee}}. ## Event To Campaign Sync Please make sure to have an associated Campaign set up before an Attendee registers or else the Attendee will not sync to the Campaign. If you need to add a Campaign to an Event after Attendees have registered, use an Attendee with a Contact Report to mass add these Attendees to new Campaign using the **Add to Campaign** button which will sync Contacts over to the Campaign. When the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Campaign}} field is defined on the {{variable.Object_Event}} and an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for the {{variable.Object_Event}}, if the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s related {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_Contact}} or {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_Lead}} is not part of the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}, then the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}'s {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_Contact}} or {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_Lead}} is added as a {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} under the defined {{variable.Object_Campaign}}. When a {{variable.Object_Campaign}} is defined on {{variable.Object_Event}}, if the {{variable.Object_Campaign}}'s {{variable.Field_Campaign_Event}} lookup is null then the {{variable.Object_Campaign}} {{variable.Field_Campaign_Event}} lookup is updated with this {{variable.Object_Event}}. ## Update Campaign Member Status You can define the {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} that needs to be set when the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers/declines/attends the {{variable.Object_Event}}. ### Add Values to the 'Member Status' Campaign Field If using custom Campaign Member Statuses, make sure to add these values to "Campaign Member Statuses" on the related Campaign to ensure Statuses correctly sync from the Attendee. 1. View the campaign you want to customize and click the 'Campaign Member Statuses' related list. Click New to add New Status. Type the name of your new Status and click Save. 2. To change the default status, click Change Default Status. Then click the dropdown menu to choose the default status and click Save. 3. To change a status name, click Edit next to the status. 4. To change if the status counts as responded, click Edit next to the status. Members with statuses that count as ‘Responded' are tallied in the Responses in Campaign field on the Campaign. ### Create/Update the Event Settings Record #### Campaign Member Registered Status When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for the {{variable.Object_Event}}, the {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} on the associated {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} is updated to the defined value, and if NULL, the {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} = {{variable.Picklist_CampMemRegStat_respon}}. #### Campaign Member Declined Status When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} declines for the {{variable.Object_Event}}, the {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} on the associated {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} is updated to the defined value, and if NULL, the {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} = {{variable.Picklist_CampMemRegStat_respon}}. #### Campaign Member Attended Status (v2.17 onwards) When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} attends the {{variable.Object_Event}}, the {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} on the associated {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}} is updated to the defined value, and if NULL, the {{variable.Field_CampaignMember_Status}} = {{variable.Picklist_CampMemRegStat_respon}}. ### Status Mapping Status mapping between Attendee and Campaign Member records is available for the following values: Invited, To Invite, Registered, Declined and Attended. To configure the mapping, go to the Campaign or Event Settings record. For all other types of statuses, custom automation will need to be implemented.
